data.narrative:
Xsight Labs is a Series D semiconductor company that has raised $281M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (Etched, Tenstorrent, d-Matrix, DEEPX) valued between $529M and $5.0B, alongside 3 public semiconductor peers (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) trading at a median 21.0x price-to-sales.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $281M raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a typical 1.5x step-up multiplier for Series D progression, implies a valuation of $422M. Peer-median analysis anchors to the $2.4B median valuation across the four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables. The public-comp approach cannot be applied due to absence of target revenue data, common among private companies.

These methods triangulate to a range of $358M (low) to $2.7B (high), with a median of $1.4B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around whether Xsight Labs' technology and market position more closely resemble the lower-funded Series C names or command the premium multiples of Series D/E chip-design leaders like Tenstorrent at $2.7B. Resolution of this valuation range depends critically on revenue trajectory, gross margins, and go-to-market traction relative to the peer set.
